all 6899 entries zlib-compressed (zlib stream with header); every one inflates to its unpacked size

notes: Compressed entries are zlib streams decoded with flate2 (miniz_oxide).

sources.covers: header, string table, debug info, user flags, object, variable, property (flag-dependent auto var/read/write handlers), state, named function, function, instruction, value tags 0-5
wstring: u16 length prefix, no terminator, Windows-1252

notes: Object size field counts itself plus the object data; recomputed on write, mismatch is a parse error. Property: auto var name iff flags&4, read handler iff flags&5==1, write handler iff flags&6==2; vanilla property flags are only 1, 3, 7.

sources.covers: Skyrim LE/SE pex are big-endian, Fallout 4 pex are little-endian

sources.result: magic bytes DE C0 57 FA (0xFA57C0DE LE), version 3.9, game id 2 in every file

notes: Only 3.9 little-endian is accepted; a big-endian Skyrim file reports BadMagic(0xDEC057FA).

sources.method: byte-level reading of Form.pex, then strict parse of all 7875
sources.result: after the debug functions: u16 count of property groups {object, group name, doc, u32 user flags, u16 count + property names} then u16 count of struct orders {object, struct name, u16 count + member names}; 5485 groups (4852 unnamed = ungrouped), flags only 0, 0x8 (collapsedonref), 0x18 (+collapsedonbase); 57 struct orders; 227 files have no debug info

notes: Flag names come from each file's own user-flag table: hidden 0, conditional 1, default 2, collapsedonref 3, collapsedonbase 4, mandatory 5. Debug info is not always consistent with the bodies: 179 debug functions name a function missing from that state and 38 have a line count different from the instruction count, so nothing validates that.

sources.method: strict parse of all 7875 + f4x-pextool pex dump --asm on followersscript, companionactorscript, workshopscript, dn070_turrethallmanagerscript
sources.result: 0x24 is (dest, value, type) 3; 0x25 struct_create (dest) 1; 0x26 struct_get (dest, struct, member) 3; 0x27 struct_set (struct, member, value) 3; 0x28 array_findstruct (array, dest, member name, value, start) 5; 0x2A array_add (array, value, count) 3; 0x2B array_insert (array, value, index) 3; 0x2D array_remove (array, index, count) 3; 0x2E array_clear (array) 1. Value tags 0-5 only

notes: 0x00 nop, 0x23 array_rfindelement, 0x29 array_rfindstruct and 0x2C array_removelast never occur in vanilla scripts; their operand counts (0, 4, 5, 1) mirror their siblings and are unconfirmed by data. Table: crates/f4x-pex/src/opcode.rs.
